reason: A desktop settings plugin that provides graphical configuration and persistence for system or manually specified HTTP proxy settings, with documented API endpoints and launcher-based environment injection for host networking.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置页中图形化配置系统或手动 HTTP 代理，并将代理设置持久化供启动器使用。
summaries.en: Provides a DSH settings interface for configuring and persisting system or manually specified HTTP proxy settings for use by the host launcher.

capabilities: Provides a settings UI for enabling and configuring a system or manual HTTP proxy
Reads the Windows Internet Settings proxy value when system proxy mode is selected
Exposes GET and POST HTTP endpoints for reading and updating proxy settings
Supports host startup proxy environment configuration through the accompanying DSH-GUI launcher
